summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. That file is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle using hex-mangled identifiers and a string-array rotation decoder — no readable source form. The package's declared purpose is a UI widget library (`dist/index.js` is a plain re-export), and there is no functional reason for the library to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque payload at install time. Installing the package causes obfuscated author-controlled code to run under a non-Node runtime on the installer's machine on every `npm install`, outside the visibility of Node-focused tooling. The install-time payload lives in `setup.mjs` + `math_init.js` while the advertised library code in `dist/` is unrelated, a shape consistent with a smuggled dropper published under the `@servicetitan` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
